# Security And Privacy Checklist: Microphone Sample Graph Foundation

**Purpose**: Validate requirement quality for local audio privacy, diagnostics, egress, secrets, and lifecycle boundaries.
**Created**: 2026-06-18
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are no-egress requirements documented for desktop audio and MediaScribe credentials? [Completeness, Spec Section FR-013]
- [x] CHK002 Are diagnostics requirements documented as metadata-only for success and failure evidence? [Completeness, Spec Section FR-014]
- [x] CHK003 Are prohibited diagnostic contents enumerated, including raw audio, transcript text, credentials, tokens, signed URLs, live local paths, private meeting content, and participant identifiers? [Completeness, Spec Section FR-014, Section SC-006]
- [x] CHK004 Are retention/deletion lifecycle boundaries documented for this slice and future derived cleaned tracks? [Completeness, Spec Section FR-015]
- [x] CHK005 Are visible consent and one-action Stop requirements included for the new microphone stream? [Completeness, Spec Section FR-007]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK006 Is the privacy boundary between local recording metadata and raw audio diagnostics explicit? [Clarity, Spec Section FR-014, User Story 4]
- [x] CHK007 Is the desktop/server boundary clear enough to prevent direct desktop MediaScribe calls in implementation? [Clarity, Spec Section FR-013]
- [x] CHK008 Are failure and recovery metadata requirements bounded to safe reason codes rather than content-bearing evidence? [Clarity, Data Model Section MicrophoneStreamHealth]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK009 Are metadata-only diagnostics requirements consistent between spec, data model, research, and contracts? [Consistency, Spec Section FR-014, Data Model Section Validation Rules, Contract Section Forbidden]
- [x] CHK010 Are deletion and lifecycle requirements consistent with the decision not to create derived cleaned audio in 037? [Consistency, Spec Section FR-015, Contract Section Local Recording Package Compatibility]
- [x] CHK011 Are visible active-capture requirements consistent with the constitution's consent and control principle? [Consistency, Constitution Section II, Spec Section FR-007]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK012 Are blocked start, failed start, failed stop, degraded finalization, app restart, and diagnostics export scenarios covered by metadata-only requirements? [Coverage, Spec Section Edge Cases, User Story 4]
- [x] CHK013 Are unsupported/self-routing input failures required to expose safe recovery metadata without content or secrets? [Coverage, Spec Section FR-005, Section FR-006]
- [x] CHK014 Are future external dependency changes explicitly out of scope for this feature? [Coverage, Spec Section Program Context, Section FR-013]
